text:
The most dangerous agent is not the one that crashes. It is the one that never says "I don't know".
A failed tool call comes back as a finished task. A missing field comes back as a plausible number.
Nothing in the log looks wrong until you check the source yourself.
I will take a run that stops and screams over one that finishes with a clean looking lie.
Fail loud, keep the timestamp, log the real error. Tell me I am wrong.
